verdict: Supports a focused first-token handoff PR with disclosed regressions; does not establish a universal performance improvement.

source.scope: Commit and hand off the already selected first token before preparing initial speculative drafts; capability forwarding and callback/error/cancellation/terminal lifetime handling. No kernel, model, prompt-cache, pooling, projection-sum reuse, staging-loader or segment-shape change.

configuration.hardware: One NVIDIA DGX Spark (GB10, SM121, 128 GB unified memory)

host.kernel_note: Read on this Spark after the runs; not logged during the 15 October timing runs.
host.driver_note: Same driver string recorded on this Spark on 16 October 2026. /usr/bin/nvidia-smi is dated 10 August 2026, before the timing runs. The nvidia-smi CUDA line is the driver ceiling, not the compiler.

toolchain.nvcc_note: Confirmed with nvcc --version inside the pinned image on 17 October 2026. Host nvcc 13.0 V13.0.88 was not the compiler.

coverage.notes: The 336 short-cell pairs exclude 28 panel anchors/primers/changed/long controls and 12 startup primers. All 376 timing pairs passed exact output/token/request equality; the omitted controls were not filtered failures. Launch-inclusive rows are additional measurements of the same startup requests, not additional request pairs.

method.per_cell_summary: Geometric candidate/baseline ratio over two matched observations of per-stream medians. Baseline and candidate geometric means and both original observations are provided. No statistical significance claim.
method.sign_convention: 100*(candidate/baseline-1); lower is better for latency/completion, higher is better for token rate.
method.ttft: First nonempty text SSE minus request send.
method.decode: (generated tokens-1)/(last nonempty text SSE-first nonempty text SSE).
method.launch_to_first: Server process launch to earliest first text in the batch, distinct from median request TTFT.
method.prompt_semantics: Fresh n4/n16 bursts use distinct prompts within the batch. A repeat burst sends the same s00 prompt on every stream after one primer; it is not one repeat of each distinct fresh prompt. At n1 the fresh and repeat cell prompts coincide. Startup n1 uses the code/chat anchor, different from loaded n1. Neither arm restores cached tokens.
method.startup_limit: Process-cold with warm/uncontrolled filesystem cache; readiness roughly27–30.5s. No storage-cold or established startup speedup claim.

correctness_and_lifecycle.sampled_controls: Both arms code/chat64-token temperature0.7 top_k20 top_p0.95 seed1234: draft-on/off tokens and output hashes match within and across arms. Sampled performance was not benchmarked.
correctness_and_lifecycle.cancel_control: Both arms disconnect after first nonempty content, before DONE; connections/waiting drain to zero; subsequent control completes.
correctness_and_lifecycle.ownership_host_fixtures: Single token/logprob commit; terminal max-one/EOS no unnecessary drafting; terminal trace resolution/allocation failure releases once; cancellation at handoff releases and skips drafts; terminal job survives another job draft failure; emitted token is never reset/requeued after LaneMemory. External drafter shared/greedy/sampled output and work equality fixtures.
correctness_and_lifecycle.concurrent_device_evidence: Exact request/token/output equality at1/4/16 streams in served panel and startup comparisons. No raw internal-state identity claim.
correctness_and_lifecycle.restoration: Existing production service and voice services restored; accepted run status complete/restored with no reported cleanup failures.

limitations: One ABBA sequence and one startup run per order; small differences are descriptive, not statistically established.
Speculative work differs in108/196 panel,48/90 forward and49/90 reverse startup pairs. Unchanged-arm repeats also differ (base64/98,candidate49/98), so no causal kernel/scheduler attribution.
Earlier first-token delivery lengthens the first-to-last decode interval even without slower completion. Actual completion regressions also occur and are retained in all metric rows.
Status prefill timing boundary moves before initial drafting; this is not evidence of faster prefill kernels.
The evolved-history control is not prompt-cache acceleration: initial TTFT-0.49%/completion+0.18%; follow-up TTFT-0.65%/completion+0.10%.
Performance figures apply to the exact changed-source hashes recorded here.
Host driver 580.178.04 and image CUDA toolkit 13.3.1.008 / nvcc 13.3 V13.3.73 are pinned above. Kernel 7.0.0-1019-nvidia was read on 17 October 2026 and was not logged during the timing runs.
independent_review: Saved raw short-cell clocks, exact request/output/token joins, startup medians and sampled/cancellation safety evidence rechecked locally for publication. No new runtime tests were executed.
